parsed.name: 通用调试物理设备
parsed.description: 一种未指明型号的通用实验室物理设备占位对象，用于表示可被系统初始化和关闭的硬件设备。现有证据仅表明其适合测试实验设备的基本上电、连接和关机流程，无法确定具体仪器类型或测量功能。
parsed.description_en: A generic placeholder for an unspecified laboratory physical device that can be initialized and shut down by the system. The available evidence only supports basic hardware lifecycle use such as power-up, connection, and shutdown testing; no specific instrument type or measurement function can be identified.

actions.description: 初始化设备，开始其基本工作状态。
actions.description_en: Initialize the device and bring it into its basic operating state.

actions.description: 关闭设备，结束其运行状态。
actions.description_en: Shut down the device and end its operating state.
